newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-CRICKET-NZ team unchanged for last two one-dayers.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-CRICKET-NZ team unchanged for last two one-dayers.

text.p: AUCKLAND, Feb 27 - New Zealand will have an unchanged 12 for the last two one-day cricket internationals against England, NZPA reports.

The national selectors, convenor Ross Dykes, Mike Shrimpton and Rick Pickard, on Thursday confirmed there would be no changes for the matches at Eden Park in Auckland on Saturday and the Basin Reserve in Wellington next Tuesday.
New Zealand cannot win the five-match series, having lost the first two, and tied the third in Napier last night.

The New Zealand 12 are: (unchanged for the last two games) Lee Germon (capt), Bryan Young, Nathan Astle, Stephen Fleming, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Chris Harris, Dipak Patel, Gavin Larsen, Simon Doull, Heath Davis, Geoff Allott.
